meta_description: Qubix Plumbing and Heating in Guildford. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating maintenance. Gas Safe registered. Call us today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Guildford? We arrive fast, diagnose on site, and fix it right first time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Guildford
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full system installations, we handle every job with care and speed.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water damage spreads fast. We attend burst pipes and leaks across Guildford within the hour, diagnose the cause, and repair or replace the affected section same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted, commissioned, and guaranteed. We handle combi, system, and regular boilers — each install includes a safety certificate and 10-year warranty on parts.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Heating gone? Most faults are fixed the same day. Annual services keep your boiler safe and efficient; we include a full inspection and safety check.

services.title: Radiator & Central Heating
services.desc: Unbalanced radiators, cold spots, or noisy pipes? We power-flush systems, bleed radiators, and repair or replace components to restore full heat throughout your home.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap replacements, pipe runs, waste fits, and full bathroom/kitchen rough-in work. We work around your schedule and leave the site clean and tidy.

services.title: Powerflush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Dirty heating systems reduce efficiency and cause breakdowns. A powerflush removes sludge and debris, boosting boiler performance and extending its life by years.

about_pullquote: I started Qubix because I hated seeing customers ripped off by cowboys charging for unnecessary work.
about_para_1: Qubix Plumbing and Heating was founded in 2006 by Paul Carter, a Gas Safe registered engineer with over 20 years' hands-on experience. From a single van in Guildford, we've grown to become one of the town's most trusted heating and plumbing firms, handling everything from emergency callouts to large-scale system replacements. Every engineer on our team is fully certified, insured, and trained to the latest standards.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on honesty and speed. No inflated quotes, no upselling, no hidden charges — just straightforward advice and professional work. Nine out of ten of our jobs come from repeat customers or referrals, because people know we'll show up on time, fix the problem properly, and explain what we've done in plain English. Your heating and plumbing work is in safe hands.
reviews_heading: What Guildford Homeowners Say About Qubix

reviews.text: Called them on a Saturday evening with a leaking boiler. Paul was here within 45 minutes, diagnosed a faulty pressure valve, and had a new one fitted by 8pm. Explained everything clearly and the price was fair. Couldn't ask for better service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the heating serviced and the radiators powerflushed. The team were professional, tidy, and friendly. System runs much quieter now and the boiler is firing properly again. Definitely booking them for the full system overhaul next year.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Burst pipe under the kitchen sink at 11pm on a Monday. Qubix answered the phone, came out same night, and had it fixed and the area dried out before midnight. Proper emergency service. Will use them for everything going forward.
reviews.author: David C.
